detail.formula: arithmetic average of last 21 common-session closes / arithmetic average of last 200 common-session closes - 1
detail.ranking: descending; top 3 at one-third each; no valuation or price-above-SMA200 filter

Unmodified Node display-contract check fails its synthetic 04:00Z availability expectation for artifacts captured later that same day. The fresh ranking passes the type guard and becomes available at 12:00Z under the existing future-capture guard.

clock_sensitive_display_check.cause: The existing test builds its available-case clock as as_of+1 day at 04:00Z. The refreshed artifact was captured at 05:57Z, which is in the future relative to that test clock, so currentRankingForDate correctly refuses it. The fixture assertion expecting availability is clock-sensitive; this is not evidence that the ranking formulas or artifact type are invalid.
